answer.reason: GEN 36:24 states one deed of Anah beyond the summary: he found the mules in the wilderness.

clauses.english: found the mules in the wilderness while feeding his father's asses
clauses.quote: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness

doubts: GEN 36:2 and GEN 36:14 call Aholibamah daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, which may refer to a different Anah (a woman), so they were not used.
The clause mentions feeding the asses, which is a minor detail kept only to place the finding.
